raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Add GB300 AgentX presets for MiniMax-M3.1-Flash, documenting the Dynamo + vLLM lanes of [SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#4468](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4468) (head `41f7dfe5`). Both presets are opt-in and only touch `recipes/models/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash.yaml`.

- **`gb300_agentx_agg`**: aggregated TP4 `dynamo.vllm` workers, one per tray, behind the Dynamo KV router with session affinity. Points for GPU-resident KV and a host-DRAM tier via `SimpleCPUOffloadConnector`.
- **`gb300_agentx_pd`**: Dynamo prefill/decode. DEP2 prefill workers (two per tray) feed one decode worker, DEP8 (throughput) or DEP16 (lower latency). KV moves over NIXL, and all ranks share a Mooncake KV store in host DRAM.

The runbooks give tuning rules rather than a fixed layout: how many prefill workers per concurrent session, DEP8 vs DEP16, `--long-prefill-token-threshold 4096` for the TTFT tail, Mooncake pool sizing per rank, `--max-num-seqs` and offload sizing. They also cover the etcd/NATS, Mooncake master, worker and frontend commands.

## Validation

- Measured in the lane's sweep ([run 40627456192](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40627456192)): 6 prefill + DEP8 at 280/320/360 sessions: 90.0k/97.1k/103.9k tok/s/GPU at 241/236/230 tok/s/user; 6 prefill + DEP16 at 300: 74.0k at 299.
- Every serving flag and environment variable of the lane's agg, prefill and decode roles is either in the presets or explained in the runbook. Benchmark-only settings are left out (concurrency lists, synthetic acceptance, client settings, cluster plumbing).
- Preset schema checked locally; `typos` and `git diff --check` are clean.

detail.body:
## Overview

Add GB300 AgentX presets for MiniMax-M3.1-Flash, documenting the Dynamo + vLLM lanes of [SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#4468](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4468) (head `41f7dfe5`). Both presets are opt-in and only touch `recipes/models/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash.yaml`.

- **`gb300_agentx_agg`**: aggregated TP4 `dynamo.vllm` workers, one per tray, behind the Dynamo KV router with session affinity. Points for GPU-resident KV and a host-DRAM tier via `SimpleCPUOffloadConnector`.
- **`gb300_agentx_pd`**: Dynamo prefill/decode. DEP2 prefill workers (two per tray) feed one decode worker, DEP8 (throughput) or DEP16 (lower latency). KV moves over NIXL, and all ranks share a Mooncake KV store in host DRAM.

The runbooks give tuning rules rather than a fixed layout: how many prefill workers per concurrent session, DEP8 vs DEP16, `--long-prefill-token-threshold 4096` for the TTFT tail, Mooncake pool sizing per rank, `--max-num-seqs` and offload sizing. They also cover the etcd/NATS, Mooncake master, worker and frontend commands.

## Validation

- Measured in the lane's sweep ([run 40627456192](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40627456192)): 6 prefill + DEP8 at 280/320/360 sessions: 90.0k/97.1k/103.9k tok/s/GPU at 241/236/230 tok/s/user; 6 prefill + DEP16 at 300: 74.0k at 299.
- Every serving flag and environment variable of the lane's agg, prefill and decode roles is either in the presets or explained in the runbook. Benchmark-only settings are left out (concurrency lists, synthetic acceptance, client settings, cluster plumbing).
- Preset schema checked locally; `typos` and `git diff --check` are clean.

@@ -378,6 +378,274 @@ strategy_overrides:
             VLLM_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT: "BLHNC"
 
 presets:
+  # GB300 AgentX under Dynamo: aggregated TP4 workers, and DEP2 prefill
+  # workers feeding one DEP decode worker. Each preset restates its engine
+  # flags, so it does not depend on the pd_cluster GB300 block above.
+  gb300_agentx_agg:
+    label: "AgentX TP4 (Dynamo)"
+    hardware: gb300
+    strategy: single_node_tp
+    variants: [default]
+    workload: "Agentic (InferenceX AgentX)"
+    description: "Aggregated TP4 vLLM workers, one per 4-GPU GB300 tray, behind the Dynamo KV router with session affinity. Seven-token DSpark draft on FLASH_ATTN and prefill CUDA graphs up to 8192 tokens. KV stays in HBM, or spills to host DRAM through SimpleCPUOffloadConnector."
+    source: { label: "InferenceX #4468", href: "https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4468", key: "minimaxm31flash-fp4-gb300-dynamo-vllm-agentic-dspark-agg", revision: 41f7dfe5e5f4a6ad1acb56ca5f2f47412fbdcbb7 }
+    image:
+      vllm: "vllm/vllm-openai:minimax-m31-flash-arm64-cu134"
+      dynamo: "1.6.0.dev20261023"
+      pip: ["ai-dynamo-runtime==1.6.0.dev20261023", "ai-dynamo==1.6.0.dev20261023"]
+    tp: 4
+    select:
+      features: { text_only: true }
+    args:
+      - "--enable-prefix-caching"
+      - "--max-model-len"
+      - "1048576"
+      - "--max-num-batched-tokens"
+      - "32768"
+    env:
+      # Pins the prefix-block hashes, so they match across processes and restarts.
+      PYTHONHASHSEED: "0"
+      # A cold start (JIT builds, graph capture, autotune) takes more than 10 minutes.
+      VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S: "7200"
+      VLLM_HTTP_TIMEOUT_KEEP_ALIVE: "600"
+      VLLM_CHAT_TEMPLATE_RENDER_TIMEOUT: "600"
+    json_args:
+      "--compilation-config": { cudagraph_capture_sizes: [8, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 56, 64, 72, 80, 88, 96, 104, 112, 120, 128, 136, 144, 152, 160, 168, 176, 184, 192, 200, 208, 216, 224, 232, 240, 248, 256, 320, 384, 448, 512, 576, 640, 704, 768, 832, 896, 960, 1024, 1536, 2048, 3072, 4096, 6144, 8192] }
+      "--speculative-config": { attention_backend: "FLASH_ATTN" }
+    # --max-num-seqs is about twice the sessions a worker serves.
+    points:
+      gpu_kv:
+        label: "GPU-resident KV"
+        description: "KV cache in HBM only: --max-num-seqs 32 for about 16 sessions per worker, 64 for up to 32."
+        default: true
+        args: ["--max-num-seqs", "32", "--gpu-memory-utilization", "0.9"]
+        select: { kv_offload: "off" }
+      dram_kv:
+        label: "Host-DRAM KV offload"
+        description: "Adds a host-DRAM KV tier (860 GB per worker) for about 40-56 sessions per worker."
+        args: ["--max-num-seqs", "96", "--gpu-memory-utilization", "0.86"]
+        env: { VLLM_USE_SIMPLE_KV_OFFLOAD: "1" }
+        select: { kv_offload: simple }
+        json_args:
+          "--kv-transfer-config": { kv_connector_extra_config: { cpu_bytes_to_use_per_rank: null, cpu_bytes_to_use: 860000000000, lazy_offload: true } }
+    runbook: |
+      The GB300 aggregated AgentX lane in [SemiAnalysis InferenceX](https://inferencex.semianalysis.com/) (`minimaxm31flash-fp4-gb300-dynamo-vllm-agentic-dspark-agg`, [SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#4468](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4468)) serves the default checkpoint text-only, with one TP4 `dynamo.vllm` worker per 4-GPU tray behind the Dynamo frontend. Add trays to scale out: the KV router spreads conversations across them. The lane measured 29.2k tok/s/GPU at 416 tok/s/user with 16 sessions per tray (GPU-resident KV, `--max-num-seqs 32`), and 95.0k tok/s/GPU at 180 tok/s/user with 56 sessions per tray (host-DRAM KV offload, `--max-num-seqs 96`).
+
+      **Image and versions.** The lane used an arm64 CUDA 13 build of the `vllm/vllm-openai:minimax-m31-flash` image (tag `minimax-m31-flash-arm64-cu134`); any build of that image family for GB300 will do. Dynamo `1.6.0.dev20261023` was installed on top: `pip install --extra-index-url https://pypi.nvidia.com ai-dynamo-runtime==1.6.0.dev20261023 ai-dynamo==1.6.0.dev20261023`.
+
+      **Tuning rules.**
+
+      - `--max-num-seqs` is about twice the sessions one worker serves: 32 up to 16 sessions, 64 at 32-48, 96 at 56.
+      - **GPU-resident KV** (`--gpu-memory-utilization 0.9`) is enough up to about 32 sessions per tray. Beyond that, multi-turn contexts outgrow HBM and evicted prefixes are recomputed.
+      - **Host-DRAM KV offload** adds `SimpleCPUOffloadConnector` with lazy offload (`VLLM_USE_SIMPLE_KV_OFFLOAD=1`). `cpu_bytes_to_use` is the budget for the whole worker, split across its four ranks: 860 GB pins 215 GB per rank. Size it from the host DRAM that is free after the engine processes are up. Lower `--gpu-memory-utilization` to 0.86 to leave room for the transfer buffers.
+      - The CUDA graph sizes go up to 8192 tokens, so prefill chunks of up to 8192 tokens also replay graphs. `--max-num-batched-tokens 32768` still allows larger mixed steps, which run piecewise.
+
+      **Running under Dynamo.** Start etcd and NATS (32 MB max payload) once:
+
+      ```bash
+      etcd --listen-client-urls http://0.0.0.0:2379 --advertise-client-urls http://<infra-host>:2379
+      printf 'max_payload: 33554432\n' > nats.conf && nats-server -c nats.conf
+      ```
+
+      On each tray, export `ETCD_ENDPOINTS=http://<infra-host>:2379` and `NATS_SERVER=nats://<infra-host>:4222` together with the generated environment and `DYN_TCP_CONNECT_TIMEOUT=120`, `DYN_BACKEND_ADMISSION_ENGINE_REQUEST_LIMIT=1024`, `DYN_BACKEND_ADMISSION_ENGINE_REQUEST_WAITING_LIMIT=1024` and `DYN_BACKEND_ADMISSION_REQUEST_QUEUE_LIMIT=2048`. Then run the generated flags with `python3 -m dynamo.vllm --model MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash --served-model-name MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash --trust-remote-code` in place of `vllm serve MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash`. `dynamo.vllm` rejects vLLM's API-server flags, so leave out `--tool-call-parser minimax_m3 --enable-auto-tool-choice` and add:
+
+      ```bash
+      --dyn-tool-call-parser minimax_m3 --dyn-reasoning-parser minimax_m3 \
+        --kv-events-config '{"publisher":"zmq","topic":"kv-events","enable_kv_cache_events":true,"endpoint":"tcp://*:5200"}'
+      ```
+
+      Start the frontend:
+
+      ```bash
+      export ETCD_ENDPOINTS=http://<infra-host>:2379 NATS_SERVER=nats://<infra-host>:4222
+      export DYN_ROUTER_ACTIVE_REQUEST_EXPIRY_SECS=3600 DYN_TCP_CONNECT_TIMEOUT=120
+      python3 -m dynamo.frontend --http-port 8000 --router-mode kv --router-session-affinity-ttl-secs 14400
+      ```
+
+      The KV router uses the workers' KV events to send each request to the worker that holds its prefix. Session affinity keeps a conversation on that worker for up to four hours; send a stable conversation ID in the `X-Dynamo-Session-ID` request header.
+
+      The InferenceX throughput points replaced block verification with synthetic rejection at the committed golden DSpark acceptance length (4.04), so every point is measured at the same acceptance rate. Production serving keeps the default rejection sampler (`rejection_sample_method: block`), as in the command above.
+
+  gb300_agentx_pd:
+    label: "AgentX PD (Dynamo)"
+    hardware: gb300
+    strategy: pd_cluster
+    variants: [default]
+    workload: "Agentic (InferenceX AgentX)"
+    description: "DEP2 prefill workers, two per GB300 tray, feed one DEP8 decode worker (throughput) or DEP16 (lower latency) over NIXL. Both roles share a Mooncake KV store in host DRAM. The Dynamo KV router routes with session affinity. Seven-token DSpark draft on FLASHINFER_TS, DeepGEMM MegaMoE on both roles."
+    source: { label: "InferenceX #4468", href: "https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4468", key: "minimaxm31flash-fp4-gb300-dynamo-vllm-agentic-dspark-disagg", revision: 41f7dfe5e5f4a6ad1acb56ca5f2f47412fbdcbb7 }
+    image:
+      vllm: "vllm/vllm-openai:minimax-m31-flash-arm64-cu134"
+      dynamo: "1.6.0.dev20261023"
+      pip: ["ai-dynamo-runtime==1.6.0.dev20261023", "ai-dynamo==1.6.0.dev20261023", "mooncake-transfer-engine-cuda13==0.3.13.post1"]
+    # Dynamo workers take engine flags only; the tool-call parser moves to
+    # --dyn-tool-call-parser (see the runbook).
+    select:
+      pd_router: dynamo
+      features: { text_only: true, tool_calling: false }
+    args:
+      - "--enable-expert-parallel"
+      - "--moe-backend"
+      - "deep_gemm_mega_moe"
+      - "--numa-bind"
+      - "--enable-prefix-caching"
+      - "--max-model-len"
+      - "1048576"
+    # The RDMA names are a GB300 tray's four NICs; use the host's own.
+    env:
+      PYTHONHASHSEED: "0"
+      VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER: "1"
+      VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S: "7200"
+      VLLM_HTTP_TIMEOUT_KEEP_ALIVE: "600"
+      NCCL_NET_GDR_C2C: "1"
+      NCCL_IB_HCA: "mlx5_0,mlx5_1,mlx5_2,mlx5_3"
+      NVSHMEM_REMOTE_TRANSPORT: "none"
+      NVSHMEM_ENABLE_NIC_PE_MAPPING: "1"
+      NVSHMEM_HCA_PE_MAPPING: "mlx5_0:1:1,mlx5_1:1:1,mlx5_2:1:1,mlx5_3:1:1"
+      UCX_TLS: "rc,cuda_copy"
+      UCX_NET_DEVICES: "mlx5_0:1,mlx5_1:1,mlx5_2:1,mlx5_3:1"
+      UCX_CUDA_IPC_ENABLE_MNNVL: "n"
+      UCX_MEMTYPE_CACHE: "n"
+      UCX_MEMTYPE_REG_WHOLE: "n"
+      UCX_RNDV_PIPELINE_ERROR_HANDLING: "y"
+      NIXL_UCX_SGL_ENABLE: "1"
+      WITH_NVIDIA_PEERMEM: "0"
+      MC_SLICE_SIZE: "1048576"
+      MC_MAX_MR_SIZE: "4294967296"
+      MC_ENABLE_DEST_DEVICE_AFFINITY: "1"
+      DYN_TCP_CONNECT_TIMEOUT: "120"
+      DYN_BACKEND_ADMISSION_ENGINE_REQUEST_LIMIT: "1024"
+      DYN_BACKEND_ADMISSION_ENGINE_REQUEST_WAITING_LIMIT: "1024"
+      DYN_BACKEND_ADMISSION_REQUEST_QUEUE_LIMIT: "2048"
+    roles:
+      prefill:
+        # One DEP2 worker on two GPUs; two per tray, as many trays as the load needs.
+        nodes: 1
+        parallelism: dep
+        args:
+          - "--data-parallel-size"
+          - "2"
+          - "--data-parallel-size-local"
+          - "2"
+          - "--max-num-seqs"
+          - "64"
+          - "--max-num-batched-tokens"
+          - "32768"
+          - "--long-prefill-token-threshold"
+          - "4096"
+          - "--gpu-memory-utilization"
+          - "0.85"
+          - "--compilation-config"
+          - '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_AND_PIECEWISE"}'
+          - "--max-cudagraph-capture-size"
+          - "2048"
+          - "--kv-events-config"
+          - '{"publisher":"zmq","topic":"kv-events","enable_kv_cache_events":true,"endpoint":"tcp://*:5200"}'
+          - "--kv-transfer-config"
+          - '{"kv_connector":"MultiConnector","kv_role":"kv_both","kv_load_failure_policy":"recompute","kv_connector_extra_config":{"connectors":[{"kv_connector":"NixlConnector","kv_role":"kv_both","kv_load_failure_policy":"fail","kv_buffer_device":"cuda","kv_connector_extra_config":{"backends":["UCX"],"enforce_handshake_compat":false,"kv_lease_duration":120}},{"kv_connector":"MooncakeStoreConnector","kv_role":"kv_both","kv_load_failure_policy":"recompute","kv_connector_extra_config":{"load_async":true,"lookup_async":true,"enable_offload":false}}]}}'
+        env:
+          VLLM_MOONCAKE_LOAD_RECV_THREADS: "8"
+      decode:
+        nodes: 2
+        parallelism: dep
+        # 48 sequences per DP rank; decode graphs cover 48 x (1 + 7) tokens.
+        # Decode also writes the KV it generates into the Mooncake store.
+        remove_args: ["--no-enable-prefix-caching"]
+        args:
+          - "--max-num-seqs"
+          - "48"
+          - "--max-num-batched-tokens"
+          - "8192"
+          - "--watermark"
+          - "0.05"
+          - "--gpu-memory-utilization"
+          - "0.95"
+          - "--compilation-config"
+          - '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_DECODE_ONLY"}'
+          - "--max-cudagraph-capture-size"
+          - "384"
+          - "--numa-bind-nodes"
+          - "0"
+          - "0"
+          - "1"
+          - "1"
+          - "--kv-transfer-config"
+          - '{"kv_connector":"MultiConnector","kv_role":"kv_both","kv_load_failure_policy":"recompute","kv_connector_extra_config":{"connectors":[{"kv_connector":"NixlConnector","kv_role":"kv_both","kv_load_failure_policy":"fail","kv_buffer_device":"cuda","kv_connector_extra_config":{"backends":["UCX"],"enforce_handshake_compat":false,"kv_lease_duration":120}},{"kv_connector":"MooncakeStoreConnector","kv_role":"kv_both","kv_load_failure_policy":"recompute","kv_connector_extra_config":{"load_async":true,"lookup_async":true,"enable_offload":false,"save_decode_cache":true}}]}}'
+        env:
+          VLLM_MOONCAKE_LOAD_RECV_THREADS: "4"
+          VLLM_MAX_ASYNC_KV_ADMITS_PER_STEP: "4"
+          VLLM_RANDOMIZE_DP_DUMMY_INPUTS: "1"
+          VLLM_ALLREDUCE_USE_SYMM_MEM: "0"
+          NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE: "1"
+          NCCL_MNNVL_ENABLE: "1"
+          NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE: "1"
+    points:
+      dep8:
+        label: "DEP8 decode (throughput)"
+        description: "One DEP8 decode worker across two trays."
+        default: true
+      dep16:
+        label: "DEP16 decode (lower latency)"
+        description: "One DEP16 decode worker across four trays."
+        roles: { decode: { nodes: 4 } }
+    runbook: |
+      The GB300 disaggregated AgentX lane in [SemiAnalysis InferenceX](https://inferencex.semianalysis.com/) (`minimaxm31flash-fp4-gb300-dynamo-vllm-agentic-dspark-disagg`, [SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#4468](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4468)) serves the default checkpoint text-only with Dynamo and vLLM. Six prefill workers, each DEP2 on two GPUs (two per 4-GPU tray, three trays), feed one decode worker that is DEP8 across two trays or DEP16 across four. KV moves from prefill to decode over NIXL (UCX over RDMA), and every rank contributes host DRAM to a shared Mooncake KV store, so a returning conversation's prefix is loaded from the store instead of recomputed. Both roles use expert parallelism with DeepGEMM MegaMoE, attention data parallelism, the V2 model runner and the seven-token DSpark draft on `FLASHINFER_TS`.
+
+      | Prefill workers (DEP2) | Decode | GPUs | Sessions | tok/s/GPU | tok/s/user | TTFT p90 |
+      |---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
+      | 6 | DEP8 | 20 | 280 | 90.0k | 241 | 3.5 s |
+      | 6 | DEP8 | 20 | 320 | 97.1k | 236 | 4.3 s |
+      | 6 | DEP8 | 20 | 360 | 103.9k | 230 | 5.8 s |
+      | 6 | DEP16 | 28 | 300 | 74.0k | 299 | 2.2 s |
+
+      The preset renders one prefill worker and the decode worker. Run more prefill workers with the same command. Two workers share a tray on GPUs 0-1 and 2-3 (`--device-ids 0,1` and `--device-ids 2,3` on `dynamo.vllm`). Give each its own `--data-parallel-rpc-port`, `VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_PORT` and `--kv-events-config` endpoint port.
+
+      **Image and versions.** The lane used an arm64 CUDA 13 build of the `vllm/vllm-openai:minimax-m31-flash` image (tag `minimax-m31-flash-arm64-cu134`), with Dynamo `1.6.0.dev20261023` and Mooncake `mooncake-transfer-engine-cuda13==0.3.13.post1` installed on every worker and on the Mooncake master host: `pip install --extra-index-url https://pypi.nvidia.com ai-dynamo-runtime==1.6.0.dev20261023 ai-dynamo==1.6.0.dev20261023 mooncake-transfer-engine-cuda13==0.3.13.post1`.
+
+      ### Tuning rules
+
+      - **Prefill pool.** The prefill pool sets TTFT, so scale prefill workers with load. The lane's points kept TTFT p90 between 2.2 and 5.8 s with one DEP2 prefill worker per 45-60 concurrent agentic sessions, so 90-120 sessions per prefill tray (six workers at 280-360 sessions). Add prefill workers when TTFT p90 climbs while decode still has room. Two DEP2 workers per tray give the router twice as many prefill targets as one DEP4 worker.
+      - **DEP8 or DEP16 decode.** DEP8 gives the most tokens per GPU: up to 45 sessions per decode GPU (360 sessions) at 230 tok/s/user. DEP16 halves the batch per rank and gives about 25% more tok/s/user (299 at 300 sessions, against 241 at 280 on DEP8) at about 18% fewer tokens per GPU. `--max-num-seqs 48` per DP rank is a cap, not the operating point. The decode graph cap is `--max-num-seqs` x (1 + 7 draft tokens) = 384. `--watermark 0.05` keeps 5% of the decode KV cache free, so extra requests wait in the queue instead of preempting running ones. Keep decode `--max-num-batched-tokens` at 8192: a preempted request recomputes its context in chunks of that size.
+      - **Prefill batching.** `--long-prefill-token-threshold 4096` chunks long prompts into 4096-token pieces. Short prompts then share each step with them instead of waiting behind a 100K-token context, which lowers the TTFT tail. The recipe's 1P1D section above uses 8192. `--max-num-batched-tokens 32768` bounds a prefill step. Prefill captures CUDA graphs up to 2048 tokens.
+      - **Mooncake pool size.** `global_segment_size` is registered by every DP rank, prefill and decode alike, so a tray pins four times that value. The lane used 160 GB per rank (640 GB per tray). Size it as (host DRAM free per tray after the engines are up - headroom for NIXL and the 4 GB local buffers) / ranks per tray. The decode ranks also write the KV they generate into the store (`save_decode_cache: true`), so the next turn's prefill can load the previous answer instead of recomputing it.
+      - **Routing.** The KV router (`--router-mode kv`) reads the prefill workers' KV events and sends each request to the worker that already holds its prefix. Session affinity (`--router-session-affinity-ttl-secs 14400`) keeps a conversation on that worker for up to four hours. Send a stable conversation ID in the `X-Dynamo-Session-ID` header. The Mooncake store catches the prefixes that miss after a reroute.
+      - **Transport.** Cross-tray NIXL needs `UCX_TLS=rc,cuda_copy` with `UCX_NET_DEVICES` set to the tray's RDMA ports. Without them, UCX can fall back to TCP and transfers stall. Point `UCX_MODULE_DIR` at the UCX bundled with the NIXL wheel (`nixl_cu13.libs/ucx` in the image's `dist-packages`). `kv_lease_duration: 120` holds a prefill's blocks for up to 120 s until decode reads them (the default is 30 s). `VLLM_MAX_ASYNC_KV_ADMITS_PER_STEP=4` caps how many requests with finished KV loads decode admits per step.
+      - **NUMA.** `--numa-bind` pins each rank to its GPU's NUMA node. Decode passes the tray's map, `--numa-bind-nodes 0 0 1 1`, explicitly.
+      - `--moe-backend deep_gemm_mega_moe` is the same as the lane's `--kernel-config '{"moe_backend":"deep_gemm_mega_moe"}'`. `--prefill-schedule-interval 1`, also set by the lane, is vLLM's default.
+
+      ### Services
+
+      Start etcd, NATS and the Mooncake master once:
+
+      ```bash
+      etcd --listen-client-urls http://0.0.0.0:2379 --advertise-client-urls http://<infra-host>:2379
+      printf 'max_payload: 33554432\n' > nats.conf && nats-server -c nats.conf
+      mooncake_master --rpc_port=50051 \
+        --default_kv_lease_ttl=60000 --eviction_high_watermark_ratio=0.95 --eviction_ratio=0.10
+      ```
+
+      Every worker reads the store configuration from the JSON file that `MOONCAKE_CONFIG_PATH` points to (export it with the rest of the environment):
+
+      ```json
+      {"master_server_address": "<infra-host>:50051", "metadata_server": "P2PHANDSHAKE",
+       "global_segment_size": "160GB", "local_buffer_size": "4GB", "protocol": "rdma",
+       "device_name": "mlx5_0,mlx5_1,mlx5_2,mlx5_3", "enable_offload": false}
+      ```
+
+      ### Workers
+
+      Export `ETCD_ENDPOINTS=http://<infra-host>:2379`, `NATS_SERVER=nats://<infra-host>:4222` and the generated environment on every tray, then run the generated `python3 -m dynamo.vllm` commands. Add `--served-model-name MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash --trust-remote-code --dyn-tool-call-parser minimax_m3 --dyn-reasoning-parser minimax_m3` to both roles. `dynamo.vllm` rejects vLLM's API-server flags `--tool-call-parser` and `--enable-auto-tool-choice`. Multi-node DEP decode runs one process per tray with `--data-parallel-start-rank` set to 0, 4, 8 and so on, and a shared `--data-parallel-address` and `--data-parallel-rpc-port`. `--data-parallel-hybrid-lb` lets every tray's Dynamo runtime register its own DP ranks with the frontend.
+
+      ### Frontend
+
+      ```bash
+      export ETCD_ENDPOINTS=http://<infra-host>:2379 NATS_SERVER=nats://<infra-host>:4222
+      export DYN_ROUTER_ACTIVE_REQUEST_EXPIRY_SECS=3600 DYN_TCP_CONNECT_TIMEOUT=120
+      python3 -m dynamo.frontend --http-port 8000 --router-mode kv --router-session-affinity-ttl-secs 14400
+      ```
+
+      The InferenceX throughput points replaced block verification with synthetic rejection at the committed golden DSpark acceptance length (4.04), so every point is measured at the same acceptance rate. Production serving keeps the default rejection sampler (`rejection_sample_method: block`), as in the command above.
+
   b300_agentx_tp4:
     label: "AgentX TP4"
     hardware: b300
